blurb: Complete your visit to Atlanta with a World of Coca-Cola Admission & 1-Hour Small Group Guided Tour. A Guided Tour grants you access to World of Coca-Cola’s exhibits, films, and experiences plus an exclusive 1-hour ambassador guided tour through our most popular areas, skip-the-line photo opportunity with the World of Coca-Cola Polar Bear, access to unique photo opportunities, and more! Enjoy our most popular area by tasting flavors from around the globe in the Taste It! beverage lounge. After your guided tour, explore World of Coca-Cola at your leisure.
